WITH team_averages AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        AVG(CAST(w AS REAL) / NULLIF(g, 0)) AS average_win_rate,
        COUNT(*) AS record_count
    FROM manager_half
    GROUP BY team_id
),
scored AS (
    SELECT
        team_id,
        average_win_rate,
        record_count,
        average_win_rate - AVG(average_win_rate) OVER () AS difference_from_mean
    FROM team_averages
)
SELECT team_id, average_win_rate, record_count, difference_from_mean
FROM scored
WHERE difference_from_mean IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY difference_from_mean DESC
LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: A win rate with zero games is missing; record count includes every manager_half row, including rows whose win rate is missing. Teams with no defined average difference are omitted because the requested mean must exist and missing differences sort last.
